title: ResearchFailureAnalysis v1
description: A domain-neutral, revisable analysis anchored to exactly one failure observation through a mandatory content-hash pin. It records the current hypotheses about the observed facts. A revision is published as a new record with a new analysis_id pointing at its predecessor through the ID-only supersedes field, forming an append-only lineage chain.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact observation record version.

observation.description: The single observation this analysis interprets. Exactly one anchor; cross-observation synthesis belongs to a higher-level object, not to v1.

hypotheses.description: Current revisable hypotheses, stated as hypotheses and never as established facts.

supersedes.description: Optional analysis_id of the prior analysis this one revises. ID-only lineage reference; earlier analyses are never edited in place.
